fee_notes: All ongoing fees stated weekly; converted to approximate monthly (×52/12). Royalty: 6% of Gross Sales or $150/week minimum. Marketing Fund: greater of 2% GS or $50/week minimum. Contact Center Fee: greater of 2% GS or tiered weekly minimums ($50–$770). Technology: $210/week. Accounting & Advisory: $85/week. Additional fees: non-compliance ($1,000–$4,000), late fees (1.5%/month), renewal, transfer, convention attendance, enforcement costs, indemnification, taxes adjustment, and lost profits.
